items.title: R-009 bounded resident worker (s1 worker)

stages.plan: R-009: implement the persistent local worker described in design.md (length-bounded JSON lines over stdin/stdout, logs to stderr, single-inference concurrency, queue bound 32, readiness after manifest verification plus fixture smoke test). Fixes: launcher sys.path now includes contracts+router+model (deployment.py). worker_stream.py reads bounded chunks via select()+Event, no more unbounded readline, idle+SIGTERM now returns promptly. WorkerService.submit() rejects post-shutdown frames as cancelled and wires TokenBucket directly into admission (R-011 now enforced in the real path, not just the isolated limiter). worker_cli.smoke_test() now runs one real decide() and checks prediction status==predicted before publishing readiness. bundle.py's locked() now separates symlink-corruption from an ordinary occupied root (I fixed a regression here: the first version misreported occupied-root as artifact_corrupt/exit 2 instead of spec's input_unavailable/exit 4). s1_contracts/audit.py's load_record() now strictly validates schema/hash-format/status/reason before replay will touch a record.
